svg.title: Self-Cleaning Degassing Water Filter
svg.desc: Cutaway and external equipment views. Key: 进水 = inlet; 出水 = outlet; 排气 = gas/air vent; 排污 = waste drain; 过滤 = filtration; 自洁 = self-cleaning. Operating duty follows project selection.
